data.name: label1.Text
data.value:
[Automatic Operation] • Click `Open` to open two PDF files, or drag and drop the files into the window. • Choose a comparison mode from the `Compare Bookmark` button's drop-down menu. • The `Jump to Prev/Next` buttons (`<-` and `->`) jump to the previous or next difference marker. - Pages that have not yet been compared are compared automatically before jumping to a difference marker. - Select the pen button (`Jump to Diffs`) to navigate between difference markers, or the page button (`Jump to Pages`) to move one page at a time. - The `Static` button keeps markers steady; the `Blinking` button makes them blink.
[Manual Operation] • The `Compare` buttons highlight differences within the comparison range. (`Space` key) - Any existing difference markers within the range are cleared before the range is compared again. - Use the `Clear All Markers` menu to clear page pairings. • The `<<` and `>>` buttons turn pages in both PDFs at the same time. (`Left arrow` and `Right arrow` keys) • The `<` and `>` buttons turn pages in each PDF independently. (`Ctrl+arrow` keys, `Alt+arrow` keys) • Use `Clear Markers` in the context menu to clear highlighted difference markers. • Use `Copy Text` in the context menu to copy text. • Use the `Copy Image` and `Copy Bookmarks` menu commands to copy PDF images and bookmark text. • The `Find...` command opens the text search window. You can search each PDF separately.
Use `Compare Page` to compare pages manually, one page at a time. Use `Compare Bookmark` or `Compare Document` to compare across multiple pages. `Compare Bookmark` compares the page range covered by the selected bookmark. Pages without bookmarks are compared together as a single range. `Compare Document` compares the entire document at once, ignoring bookmarks.
`Pan` mode lets you drag the PDF to scroll. `Text` mode lets you select and copy text. `Bounds` mode lets you set the comparison range for each PDF. The selected range is compared again, while results outside it are preserved. Note: The range set in `Bounds` mode applies to all pages included in the selected comparison mode. To compare only the currently visible page, use `Compare Page`.
After following a link to another page in the PDF, use the Back in View History button to return to your previous view.
